design.note: In the shaft, under the same graze lines, the chalk reads brighter than the clay-with-flints: the order comes from albedo alone. Measured from the car's eye passing each tier, never tuned.
The clay reads brighter than the dark topsoil under the same graze lines (albedo alone).
Seen from the car, the gilt tier frames read brighter than the glass's reflections of them: the tiers count the depth.
